opening.argument: This is an on-stage industry discussion of cryptocurrency payments, rewards, and adoption. The moderator introduces the conversation as one about crypto payments and rewards, and the panel describes a 15% Litecoin cashback benefit tied to a wireless-service arrangement. That benefit is presented as part of the service, not as a guaranteed investment return. The discussion also includes anticipated Litecoin appreciation, but treats it as a future expectation; a speaker expressly cautions that current gains do not guarantee future results. The record supports a promotional service benefit and a qualified prediction, not a claim that anyone will profit or that a particular outcome is assured.
